about: Blue Ant Media Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in streamer, production studio, and rights management businesses in Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and internationally. The company creates and distributes a slate of programming in various content genres for streaming and broadcasting platforms; and operates free streaming and pay TV channels under various media brands, including Love Nature, Cottage Life, Smithsonian Channel Canada, BBC Earth Canada, HauntTV, Homeful, Total Crime, Declassified, and Love Pets, as well as Magellan's channels, such as History and Warfare, Wild Oceans, and Cosmic Frontiers. It also offers free ad supported streaming television; subscription video on demand; advertising video on demand; cable TV; and YouTube and social media, as well as smart TV advertising sales; and engages in the production of video content, unscripted, animation, and reality competition and scripted, as well as licensing content. The company was formerly known as Boat Rocker Media Inc. and changed its name to Blue Ant Media Corporation in August 2025. Blue Ant Media Corporation was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
